name: Circus Dumbbell Clean and Press
description: A strongman event using an oversized dumbbell that must be cleaned to shoulder and pressed overhead. The huge size makes gripping and balancing the implement uniquely challenging. Athletes typically use a combination of a swing, lap, and shoulder technique to get the dumbbell overhead.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Circus Dumbbell Clean and Press in proper strongman position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare all equipment and body position for Circus Dumbbell Clean and Press.
steps: Step 1: Position over circus dumbbell. Swing handle and use momentum to pull to lap.
Step 2: Shoulder the dumbbell from lap position resting on forearm.
Step 3: Dip slightly and drive dumbbell overhead using leg drive.
Step 4: Lock out arm fully overhead before lowering.
execution.breathing_instructions: Brace core maximally before every lift. Breathe between reps if needed.
common_mistakes: Trying to strict press without leg drive
safety_considerations: Use collars on all loaded barbells.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion specific to the implement being used.
coaching_cues: Find the balanced center of the implement
